label: my approach
title:
My main principle: I work so that your website
makes it easier to tell people about you and your business

list.title: Design and marketing in one person
list.text: I look at a website through the eyes of both the client and the business. Every decision is based on an analysis of your business and your niche

list.title:
Turnkey websites
without a dozen contractors
list.text: Structure, copy, design and build — I take care of it all. No need to hire a copywriter, a designer and “someone to put it all together” separately.

list.title:
Transparent process
and realistic deadlines
list.text: I outline the stages, deadlines and way of working from the start. You always know what's happening with your project and when to expect results

list.title: Human communication, no pretension or tedium
list.text: You can explain your tasks in plain language, no jargon needed. I ask questions, suggest options and give advice when something can be done simpler and cheaper.

list.title:
Clean, modern design
without visual noise
list.text: I love minimalism and a focus on meaning and usability. No cluttered blocks unless they're useful to your visitors and to you.
